title: 第十二章 我能问你三个问题吗？
slug: 什么网恋的清冷校花竟是双胞胎
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

江南的傍晚，太阳西斜，橘黄色的光晕为燥热的天气添了几分静谧，新生们在校园里诉说着自己对未来的憧憬。

“诶，我说啊，明天军训教官不会很严吧！”

“不会吧，听说大学教官都是自己的学长学姐？”

“啊？这样啊。”

陈舟和张晚柠肩并肩地走在新生的后面，学生那嘈杂又青春的声音渐行渐远，校园里路灯也亮了起来，俩人走到人工湖旁的一处长椅上坐了下来。

独属于张晚柠清甜的声音打破了夜的沉寂。

“哟，小学弟，给学姐笑一个？”

张晚柠见陈舟这一副正经的样子，心里就忍不住得想调戏他一下，她很喜欢陈舟被自己欺负，然后那副受辱小娘子的样子。

随后她青葱的手指勾着陈舟的下巴，凑到陈舟面前的瞬间，感受着他急促的鼻息。

陈舟瞬间瞪大了眼睛，心想，刚刚不还挺正经的吗？这就放飞自我了？

一下子让陈舟本来平复下来的心又躁动起来，但他毕竟也不是刚见面时的样子了，他猛地把脸往前一凑，哈了一口气，很是闷骚的笑着。

“等我害羞呢？”

温热的气息扑面而来，张晚柠耳根瞬间染上了绯色。

啊啊啊啊，一点也不好玩，不应该是他害羞的缩回去，然后我再进一步说“小娘子，别害羞呀。”。

galgame不是这样的，你应该先害羞，然后我再进攻，慢慢提升好感度！

一被刺激，刚刚还是一副小魔女做派的张晚柠一瞬间变成了一个娇羞的小姑娘，猛地一甩头，随后把头缩在了椅子另一端，红着脸再也不看陈舟了。

扭头的瞬间，清风带着一缕洗发水的淡淡的芳香钻进陈舟鼻子里，但他看着柠柠这个模样，心里不由得有些好笑，便蹲到椅子另一头，把脸凑过去好奇地打量着柠柠。

白皙的小脸染上了红晕，莹白的手掌遮着小脸，只露出半个水灵灵的大眼睛偷偷看着陈舟。

哈哈哈哈哈，原来柠柠是高攻低防啊。

陈舟明知故问了一句。

“怎么了？”

话音刚落，张晚柠就抱着脸挪到了另一边，冷哼一声。

看着柠柠气鼓鼓地跟个小孩子的样子，陈舟不由得对她有些好奇，一个女生怎么能集可爱，高冷，活泼于一身的。

陈舟像鸭子一样蹲着往柠柠身前挪了挪，带着疑问开口道。

“柠柠，我能问你一个问题吗？”

“可以。”张晚柠把脸露了出来，弯着腰坐在椅子上，话锋一转，“但你已经问了一个了。”

陈舟知道如果自己问“我能问你两个问题吗？”她肯定会说你已经问了两个了，于是他转变思路，问的话直接超出了柠柠的意料。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

In the evening in Jiangnan, the sun sets in the west, and the orange halo adds a bit of tranquility to the hot weather. Freshmen are telling their vision for the future on campus.

"Hey, let me tell you, the military training instructors won't be very strict tomorrow!"

"No way. I heard that the university instructors are all my seniors?"

"Huh? That's it."

Chen Zhou and Zhang Wanning walked side by side behind the freshmen. The noisy and youthful voices of the students gradually faded away. The street lights on the campus also turned on. The two walked to a bench next to the artificial lake and sat down.

Zhang Wanning's sweet voice broke the silence of the night.

"Hey, little brother, give me a smile for my senior sister?"

Seeing Chen Zhou's serious look, Zhang Wanning couldn't help but want to tease him. She liked the way Chen Zhou looked like a humiliated little lady after being bullied by her.

Then her green fingers hooked Chen Zhou's chin, and the moment she was in front of Chen Zhou, she felt his rapid breathing.

Chen Zhou's eyes widened for a moment and he thought, wasn't he quite serious just now?Are you letting yourself go?

Chen Zhou's calm heart suddenly became restless again, but after all, he was no longer the same as when they first met. He suddenly moved his face forward, breathed a sigh of relief, and smiled sullenly.

"What if I'm shy?"

The warm breath hit his face, and the roots of Zhang Wan's ears were instantly dyed crimson.

Ahhhhh, it's not fun at all. He shouldn't be shy and shrink back, and then I go further and say, "Little lady, don't be shy."

This is not the case in galgame. You should be shy first, and then I will attack and slowly increase your favorability!

Once stimulated, Zhang Wanning, who just acted like a little witch, suddenly turned into a shy little girl. She shook her head suddenly, then shrank her head on the other end of the chair, blushing and never looked at Chen Zhou again.

The moment he turned his head, the breeze carried a faint fragrance of shampoo into Chen Zhou's nose. But when he saw Ning Ning's appearance, he couldn't help but feel a little funny. He squatted on the other side of the chair and put his face close to look at Ning Ning curiously.

Her fair face was stained with blush, and her fair palms covered her face, leaving only half of her big, watery eyes looking at Chen Zhou secretly.

Hahahahaha, it turns out that Ning Ning has high attack and low defense.

Chen Zhou asked knowingly.

"What's wrong?"

As soon as he finished speaking, Zhang Wanning moved to the other side with his face in his arms and snorted coldly.

Seeing Ning Ning acting so angry like a child, Chen Zhou couldn't help but be curious about her. How could a girl be cute, aloof, and lively all at the same time?

Chen Zhou squatted like a duck and moved in front of Ning Ning, and spoke with doubts.

"Ningning, can I ask you a question?"

"Okay." Zhang Wanning showed her face, bent over and sat on the chair, and changed the topic, "But you have already asked one question."

Chen Zhou knew that if he asked "Can I ask you two questions?" she would definitely say that you had already asked two questions, so he changed his mind and asked what Ning Ning expected.
